## `bin/` — Scripts and Tools

### Authentication / Session

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `bin/login.sh` | Idempotent Midway auth + SSH tunnel manager. `--check` mode (called from `.zshrc`): validates cookie silently, starts tunnel if needed. Manual mode: runs `mwinit -f`, kills old tunnel, starts new one. Tunnel is `ssh -L $DEV_DESKTOP_TUNNEL_PORT:localhost:$DEV_DESKTOP_TUNNEL_PORT $DEV_DESKTOP_HOST`. |
| `bin/assume_role` | AWS role assumption helper. |
| `bin/aws_account` | Prints current AWS account ID. |
| `bin/fast-aws-creds` | Caches `ada credentials print` output to `/tmp/aws_credentials_<hash>` for 900 s. Falls back to fresh fetch. |
| `bin/fast-kube-creds` | Caches `aws eks get-token` output to `/tmp/k8s_token_<hash>` for 600 s. Injects itself as a `kubectl` exec credential plugin. |

### Setup

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `bin/install-home.sh` | Bootstrap: `git init`, add remote, fetch, `reset --hard origin/main`. |
| `bin/setup/setup.sh` | Orchestrator: runs every other `*.sh` in `bin/setup/` in sorted order. Idempotent. |
| `bin/setup/dev-tunnel.sh` | macOS only. Installs/configures dnsmasq so `*.etarn` resolves to `127.0.0.1`. Writes `/etc/resolver/etarn`. Cleans up legacy `pf` rules. Requires `DEV_DESKTOP_HOST` and `DEV_DESKTOP_TUNNEL_PORT`. |
| `bin/setup/services.sh` | Syncs service definitions from `~/.services` to system locations. Linux → systemd (`/etc/systemd/system/`) + Caddy (`/etc/caddy/`). macOS → launchd (`~/Library/LaunchAgents/`). Idempotent; prepends a managed-by marker and prunes orphaned entries. |

### Git Utilities

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `bin/git-gone` | Cleans up worktrees/branches whose work has landed. Decision: dirty → keep; clean+landed → delete branch+worktree+remote; clean+no-remote+stale (default 12 h) → delete local only; otherwise keep. "Landed" uses ancestry fast-path then `git merge-tree` slow-path to detect squash merges. Flags: `-n`/`--dry-run`, `--stale [HOURS]`. Invoked as `git gone`. |
| `bin/rwt` | Backward-compat wrapper: `exec wt --remote "$@"`. |

### `wt` — Worktree Session Manager (`bin/wt-src/`)

Go binary (`module github.com/ellistarn/wt`, single `main` package). Manages git worktrees and OpenCode sessions locally and on a remote dev desktop. See `bin/wt-src/DESIGN.md` for the full design.

**Commands:**

| Command | Behavior |
|---------|---------|
| `wt` | Create a new local worktree at `<repo>/.worktrees/<name>`, then `exec opencode` in it. |
| `wt <name>` | Attach to existing local worktree. If not found locally, searches remote by name. |
| `wt -r <path>` | Create new worktree on remote dev desktop, then `opencode attach` via tunnel. |
| `wt -r <path> <name>` | Attach to existing remote worktree. |
| `wt ls` | List all worktrees (local + remote) with session status and title. |
| `wt -r ls` | List remote worktrees only. |

**Source files:**

| File | Responsibility |
|------|---------------|
| `main.go` | CLI parsing (`-r`, `--remote`, `-h`), dispatch to `cmdLocal` / `cmdRemote` / `cmdLs`. |
| `worktree.go` | `WorktreeEntry` struct; name generation (`MMDDTHHMM-NNNNN`); sort by most-recent-activity. |
| `discover.go` | `listLocalWorktrees` (walks `~` up to depth 6 for `.worktrees` dirs); `listRemoteWorktrees` (SSH + awk + batch stat); `parseWorktreeList` (git porcelain parser). |
| `opencode.go` | OpenCode HTTP API client: `findLatestSession`, `fetchSessionsForDirs` (parallel), `enrichWithSessions`, `enrichEntries`. Status derived from `time_updated` age (< 60 s → "working", else "idle"). Subagent sessions (non-empty `parentID`) are filtered out. Server URL from `WT_LOCAL_SERVER` / `WT_SERVER` / `DEV_DESKTOP_TUNNEL_PORT` (default 9847 → `http://opencode.etarn:9847`). |
| `ssh.go` | `sshRun` (ssh + bash stdin); `resolveRemoteHome` (cached in `~/.cache/wt-remote-home`); `toRemotePath` (translates local `~/…` to remote equivalent). |
| `git.go` | `gitRepoRoot` (local: `git rev-parse`; remote: SSH); `gitWorktreeAdd`; `dirExists`. Symlinks in repo root are resolved so paths match OpenCode session directories. |
| `exec.go` | `execOpencode` (`syscall.Exec opencode` in worktree dir); `execOpencodeAttach` (`opencode attach <serverURL> --dir <dir> [--session <id>]`). |
| `display.go` | `printWorktreeTable` (tabwriter; columns: UPDATED, CREATED, WORKTREE, REPO, STATUS, TITLE; remote repos prefixed `ssh://`; ages formatted as "just now / Nm ago / Nh ago / Nd ago"). |
| `opencode_test.go` | Unit tests for session fetching, enrichment, status derivation, partial failure handling, and subagent filtering. |

**Key env vars used by `wt`:**

| Var | Purpose |
|-----|---------|
| `DEV_DESKTOP_HOST` | SSH hostname of the remote dev desktop. |
| `DEV_DESKTOP_TUNNEL_PORT` | Port for the SSH tunnel (default: 9847). |
| `WT_LOCAL_SERVER` | Override local OpenCode server URL (default: `http://localhost:9000`). |
| `WT_SERVER` | Override remote OpenCode server URL. |

## Services (`~/.services/`)

Service definitions are managed by `bin/setup/services.sh` and synced to system locations.

### Linux — systemd (`~/.services/systemd/`)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `opencode.service` | Persistent OpenCode server (`opencode serve`) on the dev desktop. Runs as `etarn`, `Restart=always`. Exposes port 9000. Configured via env vars (`OPENCODE_CONFIG`, model, AWS). |
| `caddy.service` | Caddy reverse proxy (`Restart=always`). Reads `/etc/caddy/Caddyfile`. |
| `caddy/Caddyfile` | Listens on `127.0.0.1:9847`. Routes: `opencode.etarn` → `127.0.0.1:9000`, `vscode.etarn` → `127.0.0.1:9001`, `etarn` → file server at `/etc/caddy/www`. |
| `caddy/www/index.html` | Static index page served at `http://etarn:9847/`. |
| `code-server.service` | code-server (VS Code in browser) systemd unit. |

### macOS — launchd (`~/.services/launchd/`)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `com.opencode.serve.plist` | Persistent OpenCode server on macOS (`/opt/homebrew/bin/opencode serve`). `KeepAlive=true`, logs to `/tmp/opencode-serve.{stdout,stderr}.log`. Same env vars as the Linux unit. |
